use: Pronominal verb se souvenir de: retain a memory of something.
excluded_uses: Noun, old impersonal il me souvient and vengeance-specific use.

candidate_text.french_definition: Se souvenir de quelque chose : en avoir mémoire.
candidate_text.english: Remember something; used pronominally as se souvenir de.
candidate_text.chinese: 记得某事；使用代词式 se souvenir de。

use: Negative coordinating conjunction; coordinates elements under negation.
excluded_uses: Other languages and affirmative et.

candidate_text.french_definition: Conjonction de coordination négative correspondant à et ; notamment dans ni… ni….
candidate_text.english: Nor; negative coordinating conjunction, including neither… nor… in ni… ni….
candidate_text.chinese: 也不；否定并列连词，ni… ni… 表示“既不……也不……”。

use: Masculine plural indefinite pronoun tous; pronounced /tus/, unlike the determiner /tu/.
excluded_uses: Determiner before a noun and the separately labelled literary singular-collective use.

candidate_text.french_definition: Pronom indéfini masculin pluriel désignant l’ensemble des personnes ou des choses dont on parle.
candidate_text.english: All of them; masculine plural indefinite pronoun referring to the whole previously mentioned set.
candidate_text.chinese: 他们全都、它们全都；阳性复数不定代词，指已提及的人或物的全部。

source_support.raw_source_excerpt: # {{au pluriel|fr}} [[ensemble|Ensemble]] des personnes, des choses dont on vient de [[parler]].
: Au masculin pluriel, ''tous'' se prononce {{pron|tu|fr}} comme adjectif indéfini, et {{pron|tus|fr}} comme pronom (voir la section du pronom) :

use: Transitive verb: possession of a place.
excluded_uses: Holding a job, filling time and pronominal s’occuper de.

candidate_text.french_definition: Prendre possession d’un lieu et le conserver en sa possession.
candidate_text.english: Occupy a place; take possession of it and retain possession.
candidate_text.chinese: 占据某处；取得并保持对该处的占有。

use: Spatial preposition between stated referents.
excluded_uses: Temporal, reciprocal and restricted-group constructions.

candidate_text.french_definition: Dans l’espace qui sépare des personnes ou des choses.
candidate_text.english: Between; in the space separating people or things.
candidate_text.chinese: 在……之间；处于人或物相隔的空间内。

use: Invariable adjective; French borrowing OK, with frozen lowercase ok attested as a spelling variant.
excluded_uses: Agreement interjection and any English-language source entry.

candidate_text.french_definition: Correct, acceptable.
candidate_text.english: Okay; correct or acceptable.
candidate_text.chinese: 可以的、可接受的。

use: Frozen ADV: candidate agreement marker. Fixed French source labels this use an interjection; adverbial classification remains unresolved.
excluded_uses: Adjective acceptable and any assumption that interjection evidence independently establishes the frozen adverb subclass.

candidate_text.french_definition: D’accord, entendu ; marque d’accord.
candidate_text.english: Okay, agreed or understood; an agreement marker.
candidate_text.chinese: 好、同意、明白；表示认可的应答语。

gap: Frozen ADV is not corroborated by the fixed French source, which classifies this agreement marker as an interjection. No source-backed everyday adverb classification has been established. No substitution or scope exception is assumed.

use: Intransitive verb: human walking, the human subset of the legs/paws definition.
excluded_uses: Functioning machinery, deception, marching on something and noun marcher.

candidate_text.french_definition: Se déplacer par un mouvement alternatif des jambes, en ayant toujours un appui au sol.
candidate_text.english: Walk; move by alternating steps while keeping contact with the ground.
candidate_text.chinese: 走路；双腿交替迈步，始终有一脚接触地面。

use: Feminine noun: luck, favourable or unfavourable; not necessarily good fortune.
excluded_uses: Numerical probability and a subjective opportunity.

candidate_text.french_definition: Concours de circonstances heureux ou malheureux qui influence le succès ou l’échec d’une action.
candidate_text.english: Luck; favourable or unfavourable circumstances affecting success or failure.
candidate_text.chinese: 运气；影响成败的有利或不利情况。

use: Transitive verb: sending an object, the thing subset of the source definition.
excluded_uses: Sending a person, appointing a delegate and pronominal uses.

candidate_text.french_definition: Faire porter quelque chose quelque part.
candidate_text.english: Send something to a place; cause it to be taken there.
candidate_text.chinese: 寄送、发送某物到某处。

use: Feminine noun: narrative account of actions or events.
excluded_uses: History as a discipline, a people’s past, trouble and pretexts.

candidate_text.french_definition: Récit d’actions ou d’événements.
candidate_text.english: Story; an account of actions or events.
candidate_text.chinese: 故事、叙述；讲述行为或事件的内容。

use: Adjective: prepared/ready; prêt à faire, with feminine prête.
excluded_uses: Noun loan and temporal près de.

candidate_text.french_definition: Qui est préparé à faire ou à recevoir quelque chose.
candidate_text.english: Ready; prepared to do or receive something, including prêt à with an infinitive.
candidate_text.chinese: 准备好的；准备做或接受某事，prêt à 可接动词不定式。

use: Masculine noun: lending money or another thing.
excluded_uses: Adjective ready, sum lent as a separate selected sense and military allowance.

candidate_text.french_definition: Action de prêter de l’argent ou une autre chose, avec ou sans intérêts.
candidate_text.english: Lending or a loan; the act of lending money or another thing, with or without interest.
candidate_text.chinese: 借贷、出借；借出金钱或其他物品，可以计息或不计息。

use: Adjective: young in age, for humans, animals or plants.
excluded_uses: Youthful spirit irrespective of age, insufficient seniority and noun young person.

candidate_text.french_definition: Qui est au commencement de sa vie ou de son développement, peu avancé en âge.
candidate_text.english: Young; in an early stage of life or development.
candidate_text.chinese: 年轻的、幼小的；处于生命或发展早期，年龄不大。

use: Noun: a young person; common masculine/feminine form.
excluded_uses: Adjective young, specifically cadet and familiar address to another generation.

candidate_text.french_definition: Jeune personne.
candidate_text.english: A young person; noun jeune, masculine or feminine according to the person.
candidate_text.chinese: 年轻人；jeune 为名词，语法性别随所指的人而定。

use: Verb: acquiring knowledge or a skill.
excluded_uses: Teach someone, hear news and acquire a habit.

candidate_text.french_definition: Acquérir une connaissance ou un savoir-faire.
candidate_text.english: Learn; acquire knowledge or a skill.
candidate_text.chinese: 学习、学会；获得知识或技能。

use: Feminine noun: sixty-second time unit.
excluded_uses: Vague short moment, angular minute, original legal document and interjection wait.

candidate_text.french_definition: Unité de mesure du temps égale à soixante secondes.
candidate_text.english: Minute; a unit of time equal to sixty seconds.
candidate_text.chinese: 分钟；等于六十秒的时间单位。

use: Verb: literal drinking of a liquid; alcohol is not required.
excluded_uses: Absorbing something figuratively and noun boire.

candidate_text.french_definition: Mettre un liquide dans sa bouche et l’avaler.
candidate_text.english: Drink; take liquid into the mouth and swallow it.
candidate_text.chinese: 喝、饮用；把液体放入口中并咽下。

use: Transitive verb: guarding or watching closely.
excluded_uses: Keep ownership, preserve, retain and se garder constructions.

candidate_text.french_definition: Veiller sur quelqu’un ou quelque chose, le surveiller étroitement.
candidate_text.english: Guard or watch someone or something closely.
candidate_text.chinese: 看守、看护；密切留意某人或某物。

use: Frozen ADJ:ind: plural indefinite determiner quelques before a plural noun; selected standalone IPA /kɛlk/.
excluded_uses: Pronoun numeral use after a cardinal and et, and singular quelque.

candidate_text.french_definition: Déterminant indéfini pluriel indiquant un petit nombre de personnes ou de choses.
candidate_text.english: Some or a few; plural indefinite determiner indicating a small number.
candidate_text.chinese: 一些、几个；表示少量人或物的复数不定限定词。

use: Masculine noun: type/kind characterised by common features.
excluded_uses: Familiar guy, specimen, printing type and adjective typical.

candidate_text.french_definition: Ensemble des traits généraux qui caractérisent un genre d’êtres ou de choses.
candidate_text.english: Type or kind; the general features characterising a class of beings or things.
candidate_text.chinese: 类型、种类；某类人或物所具有的一般共同特征。

use: Feminine noun: door opening with its movable panel, literal architectural use.
excluded_uses: City gate, furniture door, anatomy adjective and forms of porter.

candidate_text.french_definition: Ouverture munie d’un battant dans un mur, permettant d’entrer ou de sortir.
candidate_text.english: Door or doorway with a movable panel in a wall, allowing entry or exit.
candidate_text.chinese: 门；墙上装有可开合门扇、供出入的开口。

use: Transitive verb: making something visible.
excluded_uses: Pointing by gesture, proving, manifesting a feeling and se montrer.

candidate_text.french_definition: Faire voir quelque chose ; l’exposer aux regards.
candidate_text.english: Show something; make it visible or display it.
candidate_text.chinese: 展示、给人看；使某物可见。

use: Familiar/popular masculine noun: a male person.
excluded_uses: Boyfriend specifically, old energetic leader, pimp and English word.

candidate_text.french_definition: Individu de sexe ou de genre masculin, dans la langue familière.
candidate_text.english: Guy or bloke; a familiar word for a male person.
candidate_text.chinese: 男人、男的；指男性的口语用词。

use: Transitive verb: wearing clothing or adornment.
excluded_uses: Carry/support, bear, reach and beer noun porter.

candidate_text.french_definition: Mettre sur soi un vêtement ou une parure.
candidate_text.english: Wear an item of clothing or an ornament.
candidate_text.chinese: 穿、戴；把衣服或饰物穿戴在身上。

use: Transitive verb asseoir quelqu’un: seat another person; traditional spelling.
excluded_uses: Pronominal s’asseoir, enthrone and establish figuratively.

candidate_text.french_definition: Mettre quelqu’un sur un siège ou sur ce qui en tient lieu.
candidate_text.english: Seat someone; put them on a seat or something serving as one.
candidate_text.chinese: 让某人坐下；使其坐在座位或起座位作用的物体上。

use: Preposition: opposition, the opposition subset of the source’s mixed definition.
excluded_uses: Physical contact/proximity, despite, adverb and noun contre.

candidate_text.french_definition: En opposition à quelqu’un ou à quelque chose.
candidate_text.english: Against; in opposition to someone or something.
candidate_text.chinese: 反对、对抗；与某人或某事相对立。

use: Temporal preposition pendant followed by an expression of duration.
excluded_uses: Pendant que clause, adjective hanging, noun counterpart and participle of pendre.

candidate_text.french_definition: Durant ; tout au long d’une période.
candidate_text.english: During or throughout a period of time.
candidate_text.chinese: 在……期间；贯穿某段时间。

use: Feminine noun: mental concentration.
excluded_uses: Care shown to a person, vigilance as a distinct sense and warning interjection.

candidate_text.french_definition: Concentration ou application de l’esprit à quelque chose.
candidate_text.english: Attention; mental concentration on something.
candidate_text.chinese: 注意力；将心思集中于某事。

use: Warning interjection; standalone exclamation attention!; frozen ONO retained.
excluded_uses: Noun mental concentration and general request for care without imminent warning.

candidate_text.french_definition: Interjection signalant un danger ou un événement imminent.
candidate_text.english: Watch out! An interjection warning of imminent danger or an event.
candidate_text.chinese: 当心！注意！提醒危险或某事即将发生的感叹词。

use: Adjective: geometrically straight.
excluded_uses: Right-hand side, upright, honest and noun legal right.

candidate_text.french_definition: Rectiligne ; qui va d’un point à un autre par le plus court chemin.
candidate_text.english: Straight; extending between points along the shortest path.
candidate_text.chinese: 直的；沿两点之间最短的路径延伸。

use: Adverb of manner: straight/directly.
excluded_uses: Adjective agreement and noun right/law.

candidate_text.french_definition: En droite ligne, directement, par le plus court chemin.
candidate_text.english: Straight or directly; in a straight line along the shortest path.
candidate_text.chinese: 径直、直直地；沿直线或最短路径。

use: Masculine noun: a legally granted/protected entitlement, the subjective-right sense.
excluded_uses: Law as a body of rules, study of law, tax, adjective straight and right-hand side.

candidate_text.french_definition: Prérogative d’agir ou de contraindre, accordée et protégée par le droit.
candidate_text.english: A right; an entitlement to act or require something, granted and protected by law.
candidate_text.chinese: 权利；法律赋予并保护的行动或要求某事的资格。

use: Feminine noun: the terrestrial year.
excluded_uses: Other planets’ years and an academic year or arbitrary twelve-month interval.

candidate_text.french_definition: Subdivision du temps correspondant à une révolution de la Terre autour du Soleil : douze mois, 365 ou 366 jours.
candidate_text.english: Year; twelve months, 365 days or 366 in a leap year, corresponding to Earth’s revolution around the Sun.
candidate_text.chinese: 年；地球绕太阳一周对应的时间，十二个月，平年365天、闰年366天。

use: Spatial preposition: under/beneath.
excluded_uses: River upstream/downstream relation, authority, temporal uses and plural noun sou.

candidate_text.french_definition: Marque la position d’une chose par rapport à une autre qui est au-dessus ou qui la couvre.
candidate_text.english: Under or beneath; lower than, or covered by, another thing.
candidate_text.chinese: 在……下面；相对另一物体位置较低，或被其覆盖。

use: Transitive verb: respectful request, including prier quelqu’un de + infinitive.
excluded_uses: Religious prayer and purely phatic courtesy formula.

candidate_text.french_definition: Demander quelque chose avec humilité ou déférence.
candidate_text.english: Ask or request with humility or deference, notably prier quelqu’un de faire quelque chose.
candidate_text.chinese: 恳请、请；谦恭地提出请求，常用 prier quelqu’un de faire quelque chose。

use: Adjective comparative of bon; masculine meilleur, feminine meilleure.
excluded_uses: Superlative le meilleur and noun the best.

candidate_text.french_definition: Comparatif de bon : d’un degré supérieur à la personne ou à la chose comparée.
candidate_text.english: Better; the comparative of bon, of higher quality than the person or thing compared.
candidate_text.chinese: 更好的；bon 的比较级，质量优于所比较的人或物。

use: Masculine noun: the best person in a comparison; feminine meilleure.
excluded_uses: Best part of a thing, adjective better and regional boyfriend sense.

candidate_text.french_definition: Celui qui est le mieux placé, le premier.
candidate_text.english: The best; the person ranked first or highest.
candidate_text.chinese: 最优秀者；排名第一或表现最好的人。

use: Masculine noun: calendar month; same written form in singular and plural.
excluded_uses: Rolling approximately thirty-day interval and monthly payment.

candidate_text.french_definition: Chacune des douze parties de l’année, comptant de vingt-huit à trente et un jours.
candidate_text.english: Month; one of the twelve calendar divisions of the year, lasting 28 to 31 days.
candidate_text.chinese: 月、月份；一年十二个历月之一，含28至31天。

use: Feminine noun: the currency of Turkey, a contemporary currency use.
excluded_uses: Former Italian currency and verb read.

candidate_text.french_definition: Monnaie de la Turquie.
candidate_text.english: Turkish lira; the currency of Turkey. French lire is a feminine noun, plural lires.
candidate_text.chinese: 土耳其里拉；土耳其的货币。法语 lire 是阴性名词，复数为 lires。

use: Verb: reading and understanding a written text, silently or aloud.
excluded_uses: Currency noun, predicting or decoding non-text information.

candidate_text.french_definition: Prendre connaissance d’un texte écrit et le comprendre.
candidate_text.english: Read; take in and understand a written text.
candidate_text.chinese: 阅读；了解并理解书面文本。

use: Verb: service to a person or community.
excluded_uses: Serve food, be useful, work as a domestic servant specifically and se servir de.

candidate_text.french_definition: S’acquitter de fonctions ou d’obligations envers une personne ou une collectivité.
candidate_text.english: Serve; perform duties or obligations for a person or community.
candidate_text.chinese: 服务、为……效力；为个人或集体履行职责或义务。

use: Adjective: a container filled to capacity.
excluded_uses: Hyperbolic very much, pregnancy, complete and prepositional plein.

candidate_text.french_definition: Qui contient tout ce qu’il peut contenir, par opposition à vide.
candidate_text.english: Full; containing as much as it can hold, the opposite of empty.
candidate_text.chinese: 满的；达到可容纳的容量，与“空的”相对。

use: Preposition plein before the container noun phrase; construction avoir X plein Y.
excluded_uses: Adjective modifying a container and adverbial beaucoup/plein de quantity constructions.

candidate_text.french_definition: Autant que le contenant peut en contenir, comme dans avoir de l’argent plein ses poches.
candidate_text.english: As much as the container can hold, as in avoir de l’argent plein ses poches, to have one’s pockets full of money.
candidate_text.chinese: 装满所说的容器；如 avoir de l’argent plein ses poches，口袋里装满钱。

source_support.raw_source_excerpt: #* {{exemple|lang=fr|Avoir du vin '''plein''' sa cave, du blé '''plein''' ses greniers.}}

use: Feminine noun: polite title madame, with plural mesdames.
excluded_uses: Regional anonymous adult-woman noun, vulgar/ironic uses and adjective.

candidate_text.french_definition: Titre de politesse employé pour s’adresser à une femme.
candidate_text.english: Madam or Mrs; a polite title used to address a woman.
candidate_text.chinese: 女士、夫人；称呼女性时使用的礼貌称谓。

use: Vulgar and pejorative feminine noun: prostitute.
excluded_uses: Insult for a supposedly immoral woman and the separate swear-word interjection.

candidate_text.french_definition: Terme vulgaire et péjoratif désignant une prostituée.
candidate_text.english: Whore; a vulgar, derogatory term for a prostitute.
candidate_text.chinese: 娼妓；指性工作者的粗俗、贬损称呼。

use: Verb: writing words with letters and symbols.
excluded_uses: Spelling conventions, sending a letter and composing a literary work as distinct senses.

candidate_text.french_definition: Représenter des mots à l’aide de lettres et de symboles sur un support.
candidate_text.english: Write; represent words using letters and symbols on a medium.
candidate_text.chinese: 写、书写；在载体上用字母和符号表示词语。

use: Feminine noun: a person’s share of a divided whole.
excluded_uses: Commercial shareholding specifically, childbirth noun and form of partir.

candidate_text.french_definition: Portion de quelque chose divisé entre plusieurs personnes.
candidate_text.english: Share or portion; part of something divided among several people.
candidate_text.chinese: 份额；某物分给多人后的一部分。

use: Feminine noun: ordinary liquid water, with the pure-state restriction.
excluded_uses: Rain specifically, chemical/ice/vapour selected senses, perfume and bodily fluid uses.

candidate_text.french_definition: Liquide transparent, incolore, inodore et insipide à l’état pur, constituant principal des lacs, rivières, mers et océans.
candidate_text.english: Water; a liquid that is transparent, colourless, odourless and tasteless when pure, forming lakes, rivers, seas and oceans.
candidate_text.chinese: 水；纯净状态下透明、无色、无味、无臭的液体，是湖泊、河流、海洋的主要组成物质。
